operationUnit: one actual string += and complete retained result
specification: Initialize a mutable target with an explicit clone of a runtime-selected string, append a directly borrowed selected RHS with actual +=, and retain each complete string. Input domain is valid Unicode of at most 256 UTF8 bytes; ASCII rows require ASCII.
notes: Input pool cloning/repetition, target initialization, operand selection, actual append and whole-result retention are timed. Native += constructs an independent owned result; JavaScript may retain immutable ropes or shared storage. TypeScript clone is identity under the existing benchmark contract; native clone costs remain visible. No per-character bridge or allocation-parity claim. Self-append and operand order are separate correctness fixtures.
